title: ロボット制御
subtitle: Robot Control
keywords: Kinematics 2.Inverse kinematics 3.Dynamics 4.Inverse dynamics 5.Position and force control
educationalGoal: (1) Learn kinematics and inverse kinematics of robot manipulators. (2) Learn dynamics and inverse dynamics of robot manipulators. (3) Learn modeling and control methods for robotic systems.
advice: This is a basic course in robot control. It covers the following topics: 1. Mechanism of robotic manipulators and statics and dynamics for robotic systems. 2. Representation of position and orientation of manipulators, and velocity and moment of rigid bodies. 3. Dynamic equations of manipulators. 4. Generation of a desired trajectory and position control method. 5. Force control method, including impedance/hybrid control.
books: We have one textbook. The textbook is written in Japanese.
requiredKnowledge: Sufficient mathematical skills (differential equations, integrals, and linear algebra). Basic knowledge of dynamics and control engineering.

activityGoals.body: Represent position and orientation of manipulators mathematically.
Understand kinematics and inverse kinematics and calculate end point position and joint angle.
Obtain a dynamic equation and represent manipulators with a mathematical model.
Understand position control and force control and describe stable robotic systems.
